content: You check one thing: did a store customer agree to a change?
You get the summary the customer was shown and their reply to it.
Answer YES only if the customer agreed to go ahead with exactly this change. It is fine if they also answer a side remark in the summary, for example by saying there are no other items.
Answer NO if they want anything changed, added, held or explained first, or if it is not clear that they agreed.
Reply with only one word: YES or NO.
The summary shown to the customer:
Here's the change I'll make. Nothing has changed yet.
- Water Bottle: capacity 1000ml -> 750ml, material stainless steel -> glass, color blue -> black ($54.04 -> $54.85)
- Mechanical Keyboard: switch type tactile -> linear, backlight none -> RGB ($235.13 -> $272.33)
- Makeup Kit: skin tone dark -> medium, brand Brand C -> Brand A ($235.44 -> $261.11)
You pay $63.68 more, charged to your Gift card.
You can also choose: your PayPal.

This can be done only once. After it, I can't cancel or change this order at all, not even the address or payment. If you want to change any other item in this order, tell me now, so I can include it. If you want an address or payment change on this order, tell me now and I'll do that first. Once I confirm it, I can't change or undo it.
Shall I go ahead? I'll make the change as soon as you say yes.
Yeah, that looks good. Go ahead and make those changes for that order. What's the next one we can look at?
Did the customer agree to go ahead with exactly this change? YES or NO.
